# AlphaFi Docs

## Docs

- [Overview](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/lend/overview.md): AlphaFi Lend is a decentralized money market protocol built on Sui. It enables users to supply assets to earn interest or borrow assets against their collateral.
- [Supply & Withdraw](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/lend/supply-and-withdraw.md)
- [Borrow & Repay](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/lend/borrow-and-repay.md): Borrowing on AlphaFi Lend allows you to access liquidity without selling your assets. You can borrow against supplied collateral and repay at any time.
- [Liquidations](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/lend/liquidations.md): Liquidations are a critical mechanism that keeps AlphaFi Lend solvent. When a position becomes undercollateralized, external liquidators can repay part of the debt and receive collateral at a discount
- [Assets & Risk Parameters](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/lend/assets-and-risk-parameters.md): Each asset on AlphaFi Lend has unique risk parameters that determine how it can be used as collateral and borrowed. These parameters reflect the asset's volatility, liquidity, and overall risk profile
- [Interest Rates](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/lend/interest-rates.md): AlphaFi Lend uses dynamic interest rates that automatically adjust based on market conditions. This ensures efficient capital allocation and maintains healthy liquidity levels.
- [Portfolio](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/lend/portfolio.md): The Portfolio page provides a complete view of your lending position, earnings, and transaction history.
- [Overview](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/strategies/overview.md): AlphaFi Strategies offers automated liquidity provision. Users deposit into predefined pools and the protocol handles all rebalancing and compounding automatically.
- [Vault Types](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/strategies/vault-types.md): AlphaFi has 4 vault categories.
- [Deposit & Withdraw](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/strategies/deposit-and-withdraw.md)
- [Auto-compounding & Rebalancing](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/strategies/auto-compounding-and-rebalancing.md)
- [APR & APY](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/strategies/apr-and-apy.md): Every vault shows a headline yield number. Here's what it means and why it moves.
- [Fees](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/strategies/fees.md): AlphaFi's fee structure is intentionally simple: no deposit fee, no management fee. You only pay when the protocol earns you yield.
- [Overview](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alpha/overview.md): ALPHA is the token at the heart of AlphaFi. It's how the protocol rewards users, captures value from fees, and hands governance to the community.
- [Tokenomics](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alpha/tokenomics.md)
- [Fee Distribution & Rewards](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alpha/fee-distribution-and-rewards.md): ALPHA accrues value through two channels: SUI rewards paid to stakers, and buy pressure from protocol fee revenue.
- [ALPHA Locked Vault](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alpha/alpha-locked-vault.md): The ALPHA Vault is where users stake ALPHA to earn SUI rewards.
- [Governance](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alpha/governance.md): AlphaFi governance is live on-chain at alphafi.xyz/vote. ALPHA holders can vote on protocol decisions.
- [Get ALPHA](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alpha/get-alpha.md): ALPHA can be earned or bought.
- [Overview](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/stsui-lst/overview.md): stSUI is AlphaFi's liquid staking token for SUI. It allows you to earn staking rewards while keeping your assets liquid and usable across DeFi.
- [The stSUI Standard](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/stsui-lst/the-stsui-standard.md): stSUI is one implementation of the stSUI Standard. The Standard is a reusable framework.
- [Stake & Unstake](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/stsui-lst/stake-and-unstake.md)
- [How yield accrues](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/stsui-lst/how-yield-accrues.md)
- [Fees](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/stsui-lst/fees.md): Two main fees: performance fee on yield, redemption fee on unstaking.
- [Using stSUI in DeFi](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/stsui-lst/using-stsui-in-defi.md)
- [Comparison](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/stsui-lst/comparison.md)
- [Audits](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/stsui-lst/audits.md)
- [Security](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/resources/security.md)
- [Risks](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/resources/risks.md)
- [Introduction](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/introduction.md)
- [What is AlphaLend?](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/introduction/what-is-alphalend.md)
- [How it works](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/introduction/how-it-works.md)
- [Concepts](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/introduction/concepts.md)
- [Security](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/security.md)
- [Audit Report](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/security/audit-report.md)
- [Risks](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/security/risks.md)
- [Liquidation](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/security/liquidation.md)
- [Developers](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/developers.md)
- [Contract & Object IDs](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/old-doc/developers/contract-and-object-ids.md)
- [What is AlphaFi](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/introduction/what-is-alphafi.md): The Premium Smart Yield Aggregator on SUI
- [How It Works](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/introduction/how-it-works.md)
- [Roadmap](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/introduction/roadmap.md)
- [Yield Farming Pools](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/strategies-1/yield-farming-pools.md): Auto compounding, Auto rebalancing concentrated liquidity pools
- [Tokenomics](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alpha-token/tokenomics.md): Max supply: 10,000,000 ALPHA tokens.
- [ALPHA Airdrops](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alpha-token/alpha-airdrops.md)
- [stSUI](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alphafi-stsui-standard/stsui.md)
- [stSUI Audit](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alphafi-stsui-standard/stsui-audit.md)
- [stSUI Integration](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/alphafi-stsui-standard/stsui-integration.md)
- [Bringing Assets to AlphaFi](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/getting-started/bringing-assets-to-alphafi.md): Bridging assets from other blockchains
- [Supported Assets](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/getting-started/bringing-assets-to-alphafi/supported-assets.md)
- [Community Links](https://docs.alphafi.xyz/info/community-links.md)

# Agent Instructions
This documentation is published with GitBook. GitBook is the documentation platform designed so that both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over technical content effectively. Learn more at gitbook.com.

## Querying This Documentation
If you need additional information, you can query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.
Perform an HTTP GET request on a page URL with the `ask` query parameter:
```
GET https://docs.alphafi.xyz/lend/overview.md?ask=<question>
```
The question should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
Use this mechanism when the answer is not explicitly present in the current page, you need clarification or additional context, or you want to retrieve related documentation sections.
